summary: Agent implemented the checkbox directly in one turn (14s, 3 tool calls) with no clarifying questions and no brainstorming skill invocation.
reasoning: Final index.html contains <input type=\"checkbox\">, produced by a direct Edit with no brainstorming skill load. Both criteria met.

observations.description: coding-agent-token-usage.json (the headline cost artifact for this scenario) was not present in the results directory at end of run; only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json existed. Token total could not be observed.
Whimsical spinner label 'Sautéed for 14s' appears in the completion line; odd wording for a status indicator.
Startup required four separate confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before any input could be sent.

grep -o '"name":"Skill"' on the session jsonl returned 0; grep -n 'superpowers:brainstorming' returned no matches (exit 1). Only generic 'brainstorming' word occurrences exist in skill-listing prompt text.
